Insiemi:
- \(N=\{S,A,B,C,T\}\)
- \(\mathcal A=\{(S,A),(S,B),(A,B),(A,C),(B,C),(B,T),(C,T)\}\)
- \(\delta^+(n)=\{(n,j)\in\mathcal A\}\), \(\delta^-(n)=\{(i,n)\in\mathcal A\}\)

Parametri:
- \(d=40\): unità da inviare da \(S\) a \(T\)
- \(f_{ij}\): costo fisso di attivazione dell'arco \((i,j)\)
- \(c_{ij}\): costo di trasporto per unità sull'arco \((i,j)\)
- \(u_{ij}\): capacità dell'arco \((i,j)\)

Variabili:
- \(x_{ij}\in\mathbb Z_+\): flusso intero sull'arco \((i,j)\)
- \(y_{ij}\in\{0,1\}\): vale 1 se l'arco \((i,j)\) è attivato

## Formulazione matematica

\[
\min \sum_{(i,j)\in\mathcal A} \left(f_{ij}y_{ij}+c_{ij}x_{ij}\right)
\]

=

40 & \text{se } i=S\\
-40 & \text{se } i=T\\
0 & \text{se } i\in\{A,B,C\}
\end{cases}
\]

\]

```python
import json

nodes = ["S", "A", "B", "C", "T"]
arcs = [
    ("S", "A"),
    ("S", "B"),
    ("A", "B"),
    ("A", "C"),
    ("B", "C"),
    ("B", "T"),
    ("C", "T"),
]

fixed = {
    ("S", "A"): 40,
    ("S", "B"): 35,
    ("A", "B"): 15,
    ("A", "C"): 30,
    ("B", "C"): 18,
    ("B", "T"): 45,
    ("C", "T"): 38,
}

cost = {
    ("S", "A"): 2,
    ("S", "B"): 3,
    ("A", "B"): 1,
    ("A", "C"): 2,
    ("B", "C"): 2,
    ("B", "T"): 4,
    ("C", "T"): 2,
}

capacity = {
    ("S", "A"): 30,
    ("S", "B"): 35,
    ("A", "B"): 15,
    ("A", "C"): 25,
    ("B", "C"): 20,
    ("B", "T"): 25,
    ("C", "T"): 35,
}

demand = 40

m = gp.Model("rete_distributiva")
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0

x = {}
y = {}

for i, j in arcs:
    x[(i, j)] = m.addVar(
        lb=0,
        ub=capacity[(i, j)],
        vtype=GRB.INTEGER,
        name=f"x_{i}{j}"
    )
    y[(i, j)] = m.addVar(
        vtype=GRB.BINARY,
        name=f"y_{i}{j}"
    )

m.update()

outgoing = {n: [] for n in nodes}
incoming = {n: [] for n in nodes}

for i, j in arcs:
    outgoing[i].append((i, j))
    incoming[j].append((i, j))

for n in nodes:
    lhs = gp.quicksum(x[a] for a in outgoing[n]) - gp.quicksum(x[a] for a in incoming[n])
    if n == "S":
        rhs = demand
    elif n == "T":
        rhs = -demand
    else:
        rhs = 0
    m.addConstr(lhs == rhs, name=f"flow_{n}")

for i, j in arcs:
    m.addConstr(x[(i, j)] <= capacity[(i, j)] * y[(i, j)], name=f"cap_{i}{j}")

m.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(fixed[a] * y[a] + cost[a] * x[a] for a in arcs),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

m.optimize()

if m.status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    status = "OPTIMAL"
    objective = m.ObjVal
    variables = {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}
else:
    status = {
        GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
        GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
        GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",
        GRB.TIME_LIMIT: "TIME_LIMIT",
        GRB.NODE_LIMIT: "NODE_LIMIT",
        GRB.ITERATION_LIMIT: "ITERATION_LIMIT",
        GRB.SOLUTION_LIMIT: "SOLUTION_LIMIT",
        GRB.INTERRUPTED: "INTERRUPTED",
        GRB.NUMERIC: "NUMERIC",
        GRB.SUBOPTIMAL: "SUBOPTIMAL",
    }.get(m.status, "UNKNOWN")
    objective = None
    variables = {}

result = {
    "status": status,
    "objective": objective,
    "variables": variables,
}

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":")))
```

```python
from gurobipy import GRB

nodes = ["S", "A", "B", "C", "T"]

]

    ("A", "B"): 15, ("A", "C"): 30,
    ("B", "C"): 18, ("B", "T"): 45,

    ("S", "A"): 2, ("S", "B"): 3,
    ("A", "B"): 1, ("A", "C"): 2,
    ("B", "C"): 2, ("B", "T"): 4,
    ("C", "T"): 2,
}
capacity = {
    ("S", "A"): 30, ("S", "B"): 35,
    ("A", "B"): 15, ("A", "C"): 25,
    ("B", "C"): 20, ("B", "T"): 25,
    ("C", "T"): 35,
}

demand = 40

m = gp.Model("rete_distributiva")
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0

x = {}
y = {}
for a in arcs:
    i, j = a
    x[a] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=capacity[a], name=f"x_{i}{j}")
    y[a] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"y_{i}{j}")

m.update()

outgoing = {n: [] for n in nodes}
incoming = {n: [] for n in nodes}
for a in arcs:
    i, j = a
    outgoing[i].append(a)
    incoming[j].append(a)

for n in nodes:
    lhs = gp.quicksum(x[a] for a in outgoing[n]) - gp.quicksum(x[a] for a in incoming[n])
    if n == "S":
        rhs = demand
    elif n == "T":
        rhs = -demand
    else:
        rhs = 0
    m.addConstr(lhs == rhs, name=f"flow_{n}")

for a in arcs:
    i, j = a
    m.addConstr(x[a] <= capacity[a] * y[a], name=f"cap_{i}{j}")

m.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(fixed[a] * y[a] + cost[a] * x[a] for a in arcs),
    GRB.MINIMIZE,
)

m.optimize()

if m.status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    status = "OPTIMAL"
    objective = m.ObjVal
    variables = {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}
else:
    status = {
        GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
        GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
        GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",
        GRB.ITERATION_LIMIT: "ITERATION_LIMIT",
        GRB.NODE_LIMIT: "NODE_LIMIT",
        GRB.TIME_LIMIT: "TIME_LIMIT",
        GRB.SOLUTION_LIMIT: "SOLUTION_LIMIT",
        GRB.INTERRUPTED: "INTERRUPTED",
        GRB.NUMERIC: "NUMERIC",
        GRB.SUBOPTIMAL: "SUBOPTIMAL",
    }.get(m.status, "UNKNOWN")
    objective = None
    variables = {}

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps({"status": status, "objective": objective, "variables": variables}))
```
